params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: RealGarant added the BAIC B40 P, B40 PRO and BJ40 SE to its database. Link our three models to them, so these vehicles get a warranty offer.

Until now RealGarant knew only "B40" and "BJ40" under BAIC, so our models B40 P, B40 PRO and BJ40 SE carried no RealGarant code and a vehicle on one of them got no warranty offer (R S1-3.24). RealGarant has now added the three models on its side and passed on KBA key numbers for them.

The platform does not use KBA key numbers. A warranty search sends RealGarant's own series code (`serieCode`, from `models.real_garant_code`), and `real-garant:mapping` reads those codes from RealGarant's API (`services/vehicle/manufacturer/<code>/series`) and matches them to our models by name within the make. So the key numbers are not needed, and no code change is needed either: one run on production picks up the new series.

```
php artisan real-garant:mapping
```

Then check that the three models carry a code:

```
php artisan tinker --execute="dump(DB::table('models')->join('manufacturers','manufacturers.id','=','models.manufacturers_id')->where('manufacturers.name','BAIC')->whereNull('models.merged_into_id')->pluck('models.real_garant_code','models.name'))"
```

What can still go wrong:

- The match is by name (case, spaces and punctuation ignored). If RealGarant named a series differently from "B40 P", "B40 PRO" or "BJ40 SE", that model stays without a code and the code has to be set by hand from `real_garant_codes`.
- No BAIC of these three models is on the platform today, so the price cannot be checked on a real vehicle until a garage enters one.
- `real-garant:mapping` is not on the schedule, while new models from Hexon arrive every Monday (R S1-3.1). A model that both Hexon and RealGarant know stays without a warranty offer until someone runs the mapping by hand. Putting the mapping on the schedule after the weekly import would close that gap; that is a separate decision.

Source: Portal mail:58.
params.title: Link the BAIC B40 P, B40 PRO and BJ40 SE to RealGarant's new series
